content.short: Cute and fun collection of vector designed Ninjas with rarity ranging from 0.9% to 68.2%.
content.description:
The Awkward Ninja is a cute and fun collection of vector designed Ninjas minted live on the Cardano blockchain. So if you are an ADA holder, you might enjoy collecting these unique and fun NFTs. They've been a pleasure to create. The Awkward Ninja was crafted using SVG, or Scalable Vector Graphics. This was to ensure they stayed crisp and pixel perfect. All NFTs are unique in the fact that no 2 are identical. With 100's of millions possible configurations and a script which prevents doubles, uniqueness was the aim.

While running through plethora of variations the output file is given a serial, in the format of Keccak256 hash based on the layers used. this can be verified against the Provenance Hash. The NFT Provenance Hash is a concatenated hash string of all serial numbers created during the output and construction of the NFTs. This proves no other NFT has been generated. During the sale of these NFTs, when you select the buy button, a random is reserved to ensure no one buys it out from under you, and you have time to make payment.
